ROW.COLUMN: (FR/EE) Potential Fraud on Senior Citizen Accounts

Financial institutions typically monitor employee behavior to check for unusual activities. This scenario monitors senior citizen???s accounts which are potentially vulnerable to money laundering and other fraudulent activity resulting from inappropriate employee behavior. This scenario detects cash transactions debited from senior citizen accounts after some non-financial transaction/inquiry. If there are malicious employees, they look for senior citizen???s accounts which tend to monitor account activity less frequently. They often target these accounts for takeover and initiate either one large debit transaction or a few transactions that aggregate to a significant amount after any non-financial inquiry such as account balance inquiry.

SELECT a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID, b.ACCT_INTRL_ID, a.HH_ACCT_GRP_ID, c.NVSMT_MGR_SEQ_ID FROM @BUSINESS@.NVSMT_MGR c inner join @BUSINESS@.MANGD_ACCT b inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT a on (b.ACCT_INTRL_ID=a.ACCT_INTRL_ID) on (c.NVSMT_MGR_INTRL_ID=b.NVSMT_MGR_INTRL_ID)

------ Primary Rule for Potential Fraud on Senior Citizen Accounts WITH ACCESSEVENT AS ( SELECT A.ACCT_INTRL_ID, E.EMP_SEQ_ID, E.EMP_INTRL_ID, C.AGE_YR_CT, AE.ACCESS_EVENT_DT, AE.ACCESS_EVENT_TM,AE.ACCESS_EVENT_TM_OFFST_TX, f_mantas_time(AE.ACCESS_EVENT_TM,AE.ACCESS_EVENT_TM_OFFST_TX) ACCESS_TM, --- Ordering the access event based on date and time to get first record RANK()OVER (PARTITION BY E.EMP_INTRL_ID,A.ACCT_INTRL_ID ORDER BY AE.ACCESS_EVENT_DT, f_mantas_time(AE.ACCESS_EVENT_TM,AE.ACCESS_EVENT_TM_OFFST_TX))RNK FROM @BUSINESS@.ACCT A INNER JOIN @BUSINESS@.ACCT_ACCESS_EVENT AE ON A.ACCT_INTRL_ID = AE.ACCT_INTRL_ID INNER JOIN @BUSINESS@.NTWK_LOGON NL ON NL.NTWK_LOGON_ID = AE.TRXN_ENTRY_NTWK_LOGON_ID INNER JOIN @BUSINESS@.EMP E ON E.EMP_INTRL_ID = NL.NTWK_USER_INTRL_ID INNER JOIN @BUSINESS@.CUST C ON A.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID = C.CUST_INTRL_ID WHERE --- Include Retail Banking Accounts A.MANTAS_ACCT_BUS_TYPE_CD IN (@Oracle_Business_Acct_types) -- Include only Senior citizen Account AND C.AGE_YR_CT >= @Min_Age -- Exclude Employee Self Enquiry AND A.ACCT_INTRL_ID NOT IN (SELECT N.ACCT_INTRL_ID FROM @BUSINESS@.NTWK_USER_ACCT_MAP N WHERE N.EMP_INTRL_ID = E.EMP_INTRL_ID) -- Non Enquiry made within Lookback period AND AE.ACCESS_EVENT_DT > (SELECT ADD_DAYS(KC.CLNDR_DT,-@lookback_period) FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 AND KC.CLNDR_NM = @Calndr_Name) AND AE.ACCESS_EVENT_DT <= (SELECT KC.CLNDR_DT FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 AND KC.CLNDR_NM = @Calndr_Name) AND (@All_Trxn_Channel_cd = 'Y' OR AE.MANTAS_TRXN_CHANL_CD IN (@Incl_Trxn_Channel_cd)) -- Include only non financial enquiry AND (@All_AccessEvent_Purp_cd = 'Y' OR AE.PRMRY_PURP_DESC_TX IN (@Incl_prmry_purp_cd)) -- Include Jurisdiction AND (@All_jurisdiction = 'Y' OR E.JRSDCN_CD IN (@Incl_jrsdcn_cd))),
CASHWITHDRAWL AS -- To Retrieve all Transactions during lookback period (SELECT DISTINCT CT.ACCT_INTRL_ID, T1.ACCESS_TM, CT.TRXN_BASE_AM, CT.FO_TRXN_SEQ_ID, CT.TRXN_EXCTN_DT FROM @BUSINESS@.CASH_TRXN CT, ACCESSEVENT T1 WHERE CT.ACCT_INTRL_ID = T1.ACCT_INTRL_ID -- Include Cash Product Types AND CT.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD IN (@Incl_Cash_ProdType_Cd) -- Exclude Cancelled Transaction AND CT.CXL_PAIR_TRXN_INTRL_ID IS NULL -- Include Source system AND (@All_Trans_Src_Fl = 'Y' OR CT.SRC_SYS_CD IN (@Incl_TransSrc_Cd)) -- Include Cash withdrawal AND CT.DBT_CDT_CD = 'D' -- Retrieve the first non enquiry record from the lookback AND T1.RNK = 1 -- Cash withdrawal maded on or after the non financial enquiry made AND (CT.TRXN_EXCTN_DT > T1.ACCESS_EVENT_DT OR (CT.TRXN_EXCTN_DT = T1.ACCESS_EVENT_DT AND f_mantas_time(CT.TRXN_EXCTN_TM,CT.TRXN_EXCTN_TM_OFFST_TX) > T1.ACCESS_TM)) AND CT.TRXN_EXCTN_DT <= (SELECT KC.CLNDR_DT FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 AND KC.CLNDR_NM = @Calndr_Name) ),
-- To retrieve frequency period date KDD_DATE AS ( SELECT KC.CLNDR_DT, (CASE WHEN KC.CLNDR_DAY_AGE =1 AND @Frequency_period='Daily' THEN 'Y' WHEN KC.WK_BNDRY_CD = 'ED1' AND @Frequency_period='Weekly' THEN 'Y' WHEN KC.WK_BNDRY_CD = 'ED2' AND @Frequency_period='Biweekly' THEN 'Y' WHEN KC.MNTH_BNDRY_CD = 'ED1' AND @Frequency_period='Monthly' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) FL_VAL FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_NM = @Calndr_Name )
SELECT distinct T1.EMP_INTRL_ID,T1.EMP_SEQ_ID,T1.ACCT_INTRL_ID,T1.AGE_YR_CT,T1.ACCESS_EVENT_DT,T1.ACCESS_TM, LOOKBK.TOT_WITHDRAWL_CT, LOOKBK.TOT_WITHDRAWL_SUM, PRIOR_BAL.NET_WRTH_AM, (CASE WHEN LOOKBK.TOT_WITHDRAWL_SUM - TRUNC(LOOKBK.TOT_WITHDRAWL_SUM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN LOOKBK.TOT_WITHDRAWL_SUM ELSE 0 END) LRF_WITHDRAWL_AM FROM ACCESSEVENT T1, -- Retrieve sum of all transaction during lookback period (SELECT SUM(T2.TRXN_BASE_AM)TOT_WITHDRAWL_SUM,MIN(TRXN_EXCTN_DT)MIN_TRXN_DT,COUNT(FO_TRXN_SEQ_ID)TOT_WITHDRAWL_CT, T2.ACCT_INTRL_ID,T2.ACCESS_TM FROM CASHWITHDRAWL T2 GROUP BY T2.ACCT_INTRL_ID,T2.ACCESS_TM)LOOKBK, -- Retrieve sum of all transaction prior to frequency period (SELECT SUM(T2.TRXN_BASE_AM)PRIOR_FREQ_SUM,T2.ACCT_INTRL_ID,COUNT(FO_TRXN_SEQ_ID)FREQ_WITHDRAWL_CT FROM CASHWITHDRAWL T2 WHERE T2.TRXN_EXCTN_DT < (select clndr_dt from kdd_date where FL_VAL='Y') GROUP BY T2.ACCT_INTRL_ID,T2.ACCESS_TM)PRIOR_FREQ,
-- To get the latest available account balance prior to the non financial enquiry made (SELECT AB.NET_WRTH_AM, AB.ACCT_INTRL_ID FROM @BUSINESS@.ACCT_BAL_POSN_SMRY AB WHERE (AB.DATA_DUMP_DT,AB.ACCT_INTRL_ID) IN ( SELECT MAX(AB.DATA_DUMP_DT) BAL_DT, T1.ACCT_INTRL_ID FROM @BUSINESS@.ACCT_BAL_POSN_SMRY AB, ACCESSEVENT T1 WHERE AB.ACCT_INTRL_ID = T1.ACCT_INTRL_ID AND AB.DATA_DUMP_DT < T1.ACCESS_EVENT_DT AND T1.RNK =1 GROUP BY T1.ACCT_INTRL_ID )) PRIOR_BAL
WHERE T1.ACCT_INTRL_ID = LOOKBK.ACCT_INTRL_ID AND LOOKBK.ACCT_INTRL_ID = PRIOR_FREQ.ACCT_INTRL_ID AND PRIOR_BAL.ACCT_INTRL_ID = T1.ACCT_INTRL_ID -- Atleast one cash withdawal happened on the same day the enquiry made AND LOOKBK.MIN_TRXN_DT = T1.ACCESS_EVENT_DT -- Take the earliest enquiry made AND T1.RNK = 1 -- If two employees made enquiry on the same day on same Account, retrieve the corresponding employee AND LOOKBK.ACCESS_TM = T1.ACCESS_TM -- Increase percentage of withdrawal Amt since last detection run AND ((TOT_WITHDRAWL_SUM - PRIOR_FREQ_SUM)/PRIOR_FREQ_SUM)*100 >= @Min_Frequency_WD -- Account balance prior to enquiry greater than or equal to Min Networth Amt AND PRIOR_BAL.NET_WRTH_AM >= @Min_Netwrth_Am -- Total Cash withdrawal after the enquiry made AND TOT_WITHDRAWL_SUM >= @Min_Trans_Am -- Atleast one cash withdrawal during frequency period AND (TOT_WITHDRAWL_CT - FREQ_WITHDRAWL_CT) >= 1

SELECT AE.ACCT_INTRL_ID,E.EMP_INTRL_ID,COUNT(AE.ACCESS_EVENT_SEQ_ID)CNT_ENQUIRY FROM @BUSINESS@.ACCT_ACCESS_EVENT AE INNER JOIN @BUSINESS@.NTWK_LOGON NL ON NL.NTWK_LOGON_ID = AE.TRXN_ENTRY_NTWK_LOGON_ID INNER JOIN @BUSINESS@.EMP E ON E.EMP_INTRL_ID = NL.NTWK_USER_INTRL_ID WHERE -- Non Enquiry made within Lookback period AE.ACCESS_EVENT_DT > (SELECT ADD_DAYS(KC.CLNDR_DT,-@lookback_period) FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 AND KC.CLNDR_NM = @Calndr_Name) AND AE.ACCESS_EVENT_DT <= (SELECT KC.CLNDR_DT FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 AND KC.CLNDR_NM = @Calndr_Name) GROUP BY AE.ACCT_INTRL_ID,E.EMP_INTRL_ID

SELECT AE.ACCESS_EVENT_SEQ_ID, AE.ACCT_INTRL_ID, E.EMP_INTRL_ID FROM @BUSINESS@.ACCT_ACCESS_EVENT AE INNER JOIN @BUSINESS@.NTWK_LOGON NL ON NL.NTWK_LOGON_ID = AE.TRXN_ENTRY_NTWK_LOGON_ID INNER JOIN @BUSINESS@.EMP E ON E.EMP_INTRL_ID = NL.NTWK_USER_INTRL_ID
WHERE
AE.ACCESS_EVENT_DT > (SELECT ADD_DAYS(KC.CLNDR_DT,-@lookback_period) FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 AND KC.CLNDR_NM = @Calndr_Name) AND AE.ACCESS_EVENT_DT <= (SELECT KC.CLNDR_DT FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 AND KC.CLNDR_NM = @Calndr_Name) AND (@All_Trxn_Channel_cd = 'Y' OR AE.MANTAS_TRXN_CHANL_CD IN (@Incl_Trxn_Channel_cd)) -- Include only non financial enquiry AND (@All_AccessEvent_Purp_cd = 'Y' OR AE.PRMRY_PURP_DESC_TX IN (@Incl_prmry_purp_cd))

SELECT CT.FO_TRXN_SEQ_ID, CT.ACCT_INTRL_ID, DV.EMP_INTRL_ID
FROM @BUSINESS@.CASH_TRXN CT INNER JOIN @MINER@.DSVIEW118745180 DV ON CT.ACCT_INTRL_ID=DV.ACCT_INTRL_ID WHERE -- Include Cash Product Types CT.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD IN (@Incl_Cash_ProdType_Cd) -- Exclude Cancelled Transaction AND CT.CXL_PAIR_TRXN_INTRL_ID IS NULL -- Include Source system AND (@All_Trans_Src_Fl = 'Y' OR CT.SRC_SYS_CD IN (@Incl_TransSrc_Cd)) -- Include Cash withdrawal AND CT.DBT_CDT_CD = 'D' AND (CT.TRXN_EXCTN_DT > DV.ACCESS_EVENT_DT OR (CT.TRXN_EXCTN_DT = DV.ACCESS_EVENT_DT AND f_mantas_time(CT.TRXN_EXCTN_TM,CT.TRXN_EXCTN_TM_OFFST_TX) > DV.ACCESS_TM)) AND CT.TRXN_EXCTN_DT <= (SELECT KC.CLNDR_DT FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 AND KC.CLNDR_NM = @Calndr_Name)

Parameter that allows the coverage of all Access Event Primary Purpose without enumerating them in the Included Access Event Primary Purpose threshold. Y: Covers all Access Event Primary Purpose regardless of the Included Access Event Primary Purpose threshold value. N: Covers only those Access Event Primary Purpose that are listed in the Included Access Event Primary Purpose threshold.

Parameter that allows the coverage of all jurisdictions without enumerating them in the Included Jurisdiction Codes threshold. Y: Covers all jurisdiction codes regardless of the Included Jurisdiction Code threshold value. N: Covers only those jurisdictions that are listed in the Included Jurisdiction Codes threshold.

Parameter that allows the coverage of all transaction channel codes for non-financial transactions / inquiries without enumerating them in the Included Trxn Channel threshold. Y: Covers all transaction channel codes for non-financial transactions / inquiries regardless of the Included Trxn Channel threshold value. N: Covers only those transaction channel codes for non-financial transactions / inquiries that are listed in the Included Trxn Channel threshold.

Parameter allows coverage of all transaction source codes without enumerating them in the Included Transaction Source Codes threshold: Y: Covers all transaction source codes regardless of the Included Transaction Source Codes threshold value. N: Covers only those transaction source codes that are listed in the Included Transaction Source Codes threshold.
The name of the calendar to be used in this scenario. This is to accommodate calendars from different countries if needed.
The code indicating the scenario frequency. Applicable values: Daily, Weekly, Biweekly, Monthly
Minimum percentage increase in total withdrawal amount since the last detection run.
Minimum age of individual customer account this scenario will cover.
Minimum account balance amount on prior to the date when the non-financial inquiry was made.
Minimum total cash withdrawal amount to generate an alert.
The list of account access event primary purpose covered in this scenario. The firm defines allowable values for the Access Event: Primary Purpose of Access Event field, as described in the DIS.

List of Transaction Product Type Codes for Cash transactions included by the scenario. Allowable values are defined in the Mantas Transaction Product Type Codes field of the Cash Transaction file as described in the Transaction Code Values section and Transaction Supplementary Guidance section of the DIS.
The list of jurisdiction codes that the scenario covers. The client defines allowable values.
List of transaction source codes that the scenario covers. The client defines the allowable values.
Number of zero digits to the left of the decimal point required for an amount to be considered a large round figure. Used to derive alert scoring variables.

Number of calendar days in the lookback period. The Lookback Period parameter should be set up depending how many days the Account Balance data is available as the Account Balance data from (Lookback Period + 1) days will be needed.
Codes that identify the business purpose or usage of this account for Oracle scenarios.
The list of transaction channel codes for non-financial transaction / inquiries covered in this scenario.
To retrive employees who are doing potential fraud on senior citizen account.
